question: Take genes lineage enriched in NK-cells alone and genes lineage enriched in B-cells alone as two cohorts. Give each size and, for each cohort, the mean nTPM in NK-cells, naive B-cells, memory B-cells and T-regs. Draw a heatmap of the ten highest-expressed genes of each cohort across all immune cell types on a log scale. Which members are CD markers? Test the two cohorts for overlap using all lineage enriched genes as the universe. Provide the table.

turns.text:
## Cohorts (HPA blood-lineage enrichment)

I used the HPA bulk-file "RNA blood lineage" classification in the `proteinatlas` table (`RNA blood lineage specificity = "Lineage enriched"`, with the enriched lineage read from `RNA blood lineage specific nTPM`):

- **NK-cells lineage enriched cohort:** 65 genes
- **B-cells lineage enriched cohort:** 301 genes
- **Universe (all lineage-enriched genes):** 2,197 genes

All 65 NK genes (and 301 B genes) are also classified "Immune cell enriched" at the single-cell-blood level.

## Mean nTPM per cohort in the four requested cell types

**NK-cells enriched cohort (n = 65):**
| Cell type | Mean nTPM |
|---|---|
| NK-cell | 52.46 |
| naive B-cell | 0.28 |
| memory B-cell | 0.28 |
| T-reg | 0.09 |

**B-cells enriched cohort (n = 301):**
| Cell type | Mean nTPM |
|---|---|
| NK-cell | 1.08 |
| naive B-cell | 601.11 |
| memory B-cell | 686.07 |
| T-reg | 1.28 |

## Ten highest-expressed genes per cohort

Ranked by mean nTPM across the immune cell types (excluding total PBMC).

**NK cohort top 10:** TRGJP1, KLRF1, XCL2, SPTSSB, SPINK2, ENSG00000255641 (unannotated), XCL1, KLRC3, RAMP1, NCAM1
(mean nTPM ≈ 96.8, 51.6, 31.7, 20.4, 11.9, 10.5, 6.1, 5.0, 4.3, 3.4; lineage-specific nTPM in NK-cells: 1154.6, 665.9, 424.2, 329.8, 143.9, 135.0, 88.6, 63.5, 70.4, 53.9 respectively)

**B cohort top 10:** IGKC, IGKJ4, IGKJ2, IGLC2, IGKJ5, IGKJ3, IGLC3, IGLC1, IGHM, IGHJ4
(mean nTPM ≈ 4269, 3632, 2417, 1259, 1025, 907, 767, 653, 639, 485 — immunoglobulin genes)

**Heatmap:** I cannot render an image in this environment, but the requested heatmap would contain these 20 rows (10 NK genes + 10 B genes) × the immune-cell columns, plotted as log(nTPM+1). Expression is essentially confined to the cognate lineage: NK genes peak sharply in NK-cells (and some in T-cell types), B genes peak in naive/memory B-cells.

## CD markers

- Among the **heatmap genes (top 10 of each cohort)**: **NCAM1 (= CD56)** in the NK cohort is a CD marker; no CD marker is in the B-cohort top 10.
- Across the **full cohorts** (genes whose symbols start with CD): NK cohort contains only **CDHR1** (cadherin-related family member 1, not a classical leukocyte CD antigen); the B cohort contains **CD19, CD200, CD22, CD72, CD79A, CD79B, CD81**. (Note NCAM1/CD56 is also a member of the full NK cohort.)

## Overlap test

The two "lineage enriched" cohorts are **mutually exclusive by construction** (each gene has one assigned specific lineage). Using all 2,197 lineage-enriched genes as the universe:

|  | In B-cohort | Not in B-cohort | Row total |
|---|---|---|---|
| **In NK-cohort** | 0 | 65 | 65 |
| **Not in NK-cohort** | 301 | 1,831 | 2,132 |
| **Column total** | 301 | 1,896 | 2,197 |

Observed overlap = 0; expected under independence = 65×301/2197 ≈ 8.9. There is therefore **no positive overlap** — the one-sided enrichment (hypergeometric/Fisher) p-value is 1.0 (the cohorts are non-overlapping by definition; if anything they are mutually exclusive, not co-enriched).

  SELECT Ensembl AS ens, Gene AS sym
  FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE "RNA blood lineage specificity"='Lineage enriched'
    AND split_part("RNA blood lineage specific nTPM",':',1)='NK-cells'
),
expr AS (
  SELECT e.Gene AS ens, e."Gene name" AS sym, TRY_CAST(e.nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS tp
  FROM rna_immune_cell e JOIN nk ON e.Gene=nk.ens
  WHERE e."Immune cell" != 'total PBMC'
)
SELECT sym, COUNT(*) AS ncells, ROUND(AVG(tp),2) AS mean_nTPM, ROUND(MAX(tp),1) AS max_tp
FROM expr GROUP BY sym ORDER BY mean_nTPM DESC LIMIT 15

final_answer:
## Cohorts (HPA blood-lineage enrichment)

I used the HPA bulk-file "RNA blood lineage" classification in the `proteinatlas` table (`RNA blood lineage specificity = "Lineage enriched"`, with the enriched lineage read from `RNA blood lineage specific nTPM`):

- **NK-cells lineage enriched cohort:** 65 genes
- **B-cells lineage enriched cohort:** 301 genes
- **Universe (all lineage-enriched genes):** 2,197 genes

All 65 NK genes (and 301 B genes) are also classified "Immune cell enriched" at the single-cell-blood level.

## Mean nTPM per cohort in the four requested cell types

**NK-cells enriched cohort (n = 65):**
| Cell type | Mean nTPM |
|---|---|
| NK-cell | 52.46 |
| naive B-cell | 0.28 |
| memory B-cell | 0.28 |
| T-reg | 0.09 |

**B-cells enriched cohort (n = 301):**
| Cell type | Mean nTPM |
|---|---|
| NK-cell | 1.08 |
| naive B-cell | 601.11 |
| memory B-cell | 686.07 |
| T-reg | 1.28 |

## Ten highest-expressed genes per cohort

Ranked by mean nTPM across the immune cell types (excluding total PBMC).

**NK cohort top 10:** TRGJP1, KLRF1, XCL2, SPTSSB, SPINK2, ENSG00000255641 (unannotated), XCL1, KLRC3, RAMP1, NCAM1
(mean nTPM ≈ 96.8, 51.6, 31.7, 20.4, 11.9, 10.5, 6.1, 5.0, 4.3, 3.4; lineage-specific nTPM in NK-cells: 1154.6, 665.9, 424.2, 329.8, 143.9, 135.0, 88.6, 63.5, 70.4, 53.9 respectively)

**B cohort top 10:** IGKC, IGKJ4, IGKJ2, IGLC2, IGKJ5, IGKJ3, IGLC3, IGLC1, IGHM, IGHJ4
(mean nTPM ≈ 4269, 3632, 2417, 1259, 1025, 907, 767, 653, 639, 485 — immunoglobulin genes)

**Heatmap:** I cannot render an image in this environment, but the requested heatmap would contain these 20 rows (10 NK genes + 10 B genes) × the immune-cell columns, plotted as log(nTPM+1). Expression is essentially confined to the cognate lineage: NK genes peak sharply in NK-cells (and some in T-cell types), B genes peak in naive/memory B-cells.

## CD markers

- Among the **heatmap genes (top 10 of each cohort)**: **NCAM1 (= CD56)** in the NK cohort is a CD marker; no CD marker is in the B-cohort top 10.
- Across the **full cohorts** (genes whose symbols start with CD): NK cohort contains only **CDHR1** (cadherin-related family member 1, not a classical leukocyte CD antigen); the B cohort contains **CD19, CD200, CD22, CD72, CD79A, CD79B, CD81**. (Note NCAM1/CD56 is also a member of the full NK cohort.)

## Overlap test

The two "lineage enriched" cohorts are **mutually exclusive by construction** (each gene has one assigned specific lineage). Using all 2,197 lineage-enriched genes as the universe:

|  | In B-cohort | Not in B-cohort | Row total |
|---|---|---|---|
| **In NK-cohort** | 0 | 65 | 65 |
| **Not in NK-cohort** | 301 | 1,831 | 2,132 |
| **Column total** | 301 | 1,896 | 2,197 |

Observed overlap = 0; expected under independence = 65×301/2197 ≈ 8.9. There is therefore **no positive overlap** — the one-sided enrichment (hypergeometric/Fisher) p-value is 1.0 (the cohorts are non-overlapping by definition; if anything they are mutually exclusive, not co-enriched).
